messages.content: 請問在英里單位下，火星和金星之間的距離是多少？再問火星和木星之間的距離是多少？假設函數'calculate_distance'需要兩個天體的名稱和計量單位。

function.name: calculate_distance
function.description: Calculate the distance between two celestial bodies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit.description: The unit of measurement, default is 'kilometers'.
